$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure Subscriptions. See aws/s3.json for the contract.

azure.subscriptions.overview.title: Subscription overview (get, rename) over ARM
limitations: Vyomi simulates exactly one subscription — renaming it changes the one simulated subscription's display name rather than creating or listing an independent additional subscription. Offer, Offer ID, Parent management group and Secure score are not modeled.

azure.subscriptions.activity_log.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity.

azure.subscriptions.access_control_iam.title: Access control (IAM) — role assignments and definitions
limitations: Role assignments/definitions are the generic ARM catalog store (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments, roleDefinitions) and no access decisions are evaluated — every data-plane call succeeds regardless of what is assigned. Deny assignments and classic administrators are always empty.

azure.subscriptions.resources.title: Resources (Settings > Resources — every resource group in the subscription, at once)

azure.subscriptions.deployments.title: Deployments (Microsoft.Resources/deployments) history, subscription scope
limitations: Deployment creation stores whatever template/parameters/mode the client sends and returns Succeeded immediately — there is no template-language evaluation (no parameter/variable resolution, no dependsOn ordering) and nothing is actually provisioned from it; the underlying resources still need their own PUT calls. Cancel and Redeploy are not simulated.

azure.subscriptions.resource_locks.title: Resource locks (Microsoft.Authorization/locks), scoped to the subscription itself

azure.subscriptions.usage_quotas.title: Usage + quotas
limitations: Per-resource-type, per-location compute/network quota (Microsoft.Compute usages) is not modeled — Vyomi has no fixed quantity caps to report against.

azure.subscriptions.menu_gaps.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Security, Events, Advisor recommendations, Invoices, Partner information, Programmatic deployment, Billing properties, Preview features, Policies, Management certificates, My permissions, Deployment stacks, Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These subscription blade menu items are billing-account, Microsoft Defender, Azure Policy, Microsoft Entra or classic Service Management features with no Vyomi backend.

azure.subscriptions.cost_management.title: Cost analysis, budgets and cost alerts, subscription scope
